---
title: Callout numbering
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
crossref:
  chapters: true
language:
  callout-tip-title: Hint
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'Note 1.1' 'Hint 1.1' 'Note 2.1' 'Note 2.2' 'Hint 2.1' 'See Note 2.2'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - '#let callout-numbering = typst-extras-wrap\(callout-numbering, "1"\)'
---

# One

::: {#nte-one .callout-note}
First note.
:::

::: {#tip-one .callout-tip}
First tip.
:::

# Two

::: {#nte-two .callout-note}
Second chapter note.
:::

::: {#nte-three .callout-note}
Another note.
:::

::: {#tip-two .callout-tip}
Second chapter tip.
:::

See @nte-three.
